articles.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
articles.snippet: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

articles.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
articles.snippet: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

articles.title: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar
articles.snippet: From Goldman and Citi’s $270 million “Project Faro” to SoFi, Anchorage, Mastercard, Visa and Circle, traditional finance is racing to claim the onchain dollar once dominated by Tether and Circle.
